mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing clear skies around the Military Ridge State Trail with a temperature of 51 degrees, which feels more like 42.
The city has been focused on safety following an arrest last Thursday, while also encouraging residents to check their updated zoning maps and polling locations online at the city website.
There is plenty to do with the Dane County Farmers Market today, live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company today, plus yoga this Sunday and trivia starting Monday.
Last Thursday, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after reports of dangerous driving, though thankfully no one was injured during the incident.
Treat yourself to today's flavor, Chocolate Volcano, at your local Culver's, which is currently open and serving until 10:30 PM tonight.
